text:
The shape with three sides is a triangle.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the text:

Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had just watched one too many superhero origin stories. He spotted the new weight machine and thought, "This is my moment. I am the apex predator of cardio." He approached the machine with the confidence of a king claiming his throne, strapping himself in with the precision of a bomb disposal expert.

But then, the machine won.

Instead of lifting weights, Chris found himself in an awkward, mechanical hug that felt less like a workout and more like a hostage situation. He was stuck, limbs flailing, searching frantically for a release button that seemed to have been designed by someone who hated joy. From the outside, it looked like he was trying to high-five a robot that had rejected him. The nearby gym-goers didn’t just chuckle; they were wheezing. One woman actually dropped her protein shake. Chris wasn’t building muscle; he was building a legend. And not the good kind. He was the legend of the guy who got stuck in a chair.
